maddeler.e:
نصحام (form XI)
# نَصْحَامُّ (naṣḥāmmu) /nasˤ.ħaːm.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِصْحَامَّ (iṣḥāmma)
# نَصْحَامَّ (naṣḥāmma) /nasˤ.ħaːm.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْحَامَّ (iṣḥāmma)
# نَصْحَامِّ (naṣḥāmmi) /nasˤ.ħaːm.mi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِصْحَامَّ (iṣḥāmma)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
